example.title: Gottfried Gustav Pitz barn, US Highway 34

brief: Small German-built bank barn: a soft red-brick lower storey with small square stable windows and a plank door, carrying a tall steep-gabled upper storey of weathered vertical board siding with a rusted corrugated metal roof. Gable ends face the lane; vines and volunteer trees crowd its walls. Houses the Voeltz hogs below and hay above.
